review.unsignedBody: LocalAI pins it to the commit below and installs exactly the files you review here. Read what it adds before you install it.
review.codeBody: The code runs only in the Sandbox of a chat that uses the plugin, never on the host.
review.read: I read the code files, and I accept that this code runs in the Sandbox of every chat that uses the plugin.

scopeOnly.user: It is installed for you only, and starts on.
scopeOnly.instance: It is installed for everyone. Each person turns it on for themselves.

components.none: This plugin adds nothing that LocalAI uses.

skipped.unsupported: LocalAI does not support this part.
skipped.ignored: The plugin format ignores this part.
skipped.invalid: This part could not be read.

reasons.shell-injection: shell command in a skill or command
reasons.mcp-headers-helper: headers command of an MCP server

installed.loadFailed: Could not load the installed plugins.
installed.emptyBody: A plugin adds skills, commands and connectors to your chats. Find one in Browse.
installed.instanceNote: Each person turns these on for themselves.
installed.reenableTitle: This plugin now runs code in your Sandbox
installed.reenableBody: An update added code to it, so it is off in your chats until you turn it on again.
installed.reenableConfirm: This plugin now runs code in your Sandbox. Turn it on only if you accept that code in your chats.
installed.removeEveryone: The plugin goes for everyone, with each person's switch and the connectors it made. Files it wrote in people's homes stay.
installed.removeMine: The plugin and the connectors it made go. Files it wrote in your home stay.
installed.rollbackBody: The version installed before this one comes back. Chats use it from their next message.

settings.title: Settings of {{name}}
settings.description: Your own settings of this plugin. They apply when you save.
settings.secretTitle: Secret settings come in a later version
settings.secretBody: LocalAI cannot store these yet: {{names}}. The parts of the plugin that need them are skipped.

update.title: Update {{name}}
update.checking: Fetching the new version and comparing the files…
update.gainsCodeBody: After the update, the plugin is off for each person until they turn it on again.
update.tickEach: Read each change, then tick each file below.
update.truncated: Some changes are too long to show here. Open the files from the details of the plugin after the update.
update.newCodeFilesBody: These files did not change, but the new version runs them. Read each one in full.
update.codeItemsBody: Hooks, servers and programs that run in the Sandbox. Some come from the marketplace entry and are in no file.
update.reviewedItems: I reviewed the code the new version adds

marketplaces.intro: The places plugins come from. An administrator adds and refreshes them.
marketplaces.introAdmin: The places plugins come from. LocalAI reads each one every 6 hours and never installs anything by itself.
marketplaces.addDescription: A git repository with .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, or the https address of that file. LocalAI reads it at once.
marketplaces.sourceHelp: owner/repo on GitHub, an https git address, or an https address of a marketplace.json file.
marketplaces.idHelp: Empty takes the name from marketplace.json. Plugin IDs end with it: name@marketplace.
marketplaces.emptyAdmin: Add a marketplace to browse its plugins.
marketplaces.emptyUser: An administrator adds the marketplaces that plugins come from.
marketplaces.removeBody: Its plugins leave Browse. Plugins installed from it stay installed.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.
errors.network: The server did not answer. Check the connection and try again.
errors.invalid_token: This review expired or was used already. Review the plugin again.
errors.needs_admin: Only an administrator can install this plugin.
errors.code_for_everyone: A plugin that runs code is installed for everyone only.
errors.blocked: This version runs code. An administrator must install it.
errors.not_human_surface: This change needs your own browser session. Sign in from your browser and try again.
errors.not_found: This plugin or marketplace no longer exists.
errors.conflict: This plugin is installed already, or it changed meanwhile.
errors.instance_installed: This plugin is installed for everyone already. Turn it on in Installed.
errors.no_update: This plugin is at the latest version.
errors.needs_reenable: This plugin now runs code. Turn it on again to accept it.
errors.unsupported: LocalAI does not support this yet.
errors.content_refused: A file of this plugin failed the checks, so LocalAI refused it.
errors.limit_reached: The limit of marketplaces or installs is reached.
errors.fetch_failed: LocalAI could not read the plugin or the marketplace. The server log has the cause.
errors.plugins_unavailable: Plugins are not available on this server.
errors.rate_limited: Too many plugin reviews right now. Wait a moment and try again.

job.unknown: {{name}} is not in the list yet. The change may still run, or it failed: your notifications say how it ended.
